verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only web-based e-filing, public search, and status-tracking portals for human users. Nothing in it describes a documented public API with endpoints, authentication, or developer reference, and the llms.txt probe returned HTTP 404. A government IP office could plausibly publish an API, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
